pages.title: White-Tailed Deer
pages.text: The white-tailed deer ($(o)Odocoileus virginianus$()) is a medium-sized deer found throughout most of North America, Central America and northern South America.$(br2)When alarmed, it raises its tail to flash the bright white underside as a warning to other deer.$(br2)White-tailed deer are highly adaptable, living in forests, farmland, swamps and suburbs, and they are the most widespread wild hoofed animal in the Americas.
